common_mask: intersection legal original codes in H2000,H2010,H2015,H2020,W2020; same mask in all experiments and composition
distance: WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic between geometric window centers

sample.first_each_group: uniform random among distance-eligible sorted row/col candidates
sample.subsequent: global maximin to all previously selected windows

experiment1.reference: native any-class change at corresponding semantic level

experiment2.phase_core: [30:n-30,30:n-30] on both axes; same for all phases
experiment2.phase_cells: every positive core-overlap jointly decidable block counts once; area weighted by core overlap

experiment3.refinement: either epoch max coarse proportion < .90 => native in both
experiment3.reference: native SL binary; internal product preservation, not ground truth

metrics.unknown_change: abstention; positive reference counted FN; report coverage
metrics.unknown_area: [L,L+unknown]; primary worst-case absolute deviation; signed bias interval

statistics.test: two-sided exact paired sign-flip test of mean difference, enumerate all 2^n
statistics.effect: mean and median paired difference plus paired rank-biserial descriptive
statistics.missing: complete finite pairs with n and missing reported; no replacement; NA remains in planned family as p=1 placeholder
statistics.secondary: descriptive estimates and window bootstrap CI only; no secondary p-values

storage.common: full uint8 valid mask and per-row float64 areas included and charged separately to every artifact
storage.cost: sum array nbytes + metadata bytes; actual NPZ + JSON bytes; native three-class expression same accounting
